bootstrap.method: paired stratified system bootstrap, percentile 95% intervals; fixed prevalence; no model refitting

top10_ties: Expected capture under random tie-breaking at the top-k boundary; k=floor(0.10*n).
normalization_cohort: All eligible non-Failing baseline systems, before filtering to known outcomes or At-Risk systems.

calibration_artifact.target: Assessment snapshot transition; annual failure calibration unverified
calibration_artifact.selection_rule: Lowest mean outer-fold log loss; prefer identity, then intercept, then logit_ridge within 0.001 of minimum. No test-year inputs.
limitations: Within one training transition; not forward-year validation.
Base configurations selected using the entire training transition; model selection is not nested.
Few training onsets; no subgroup-specific calibration or isotonic fitting.
Assessment status reference dates and July stage-1 cutoffs differ; some outcomes precede nominal prediction cutoffs. Annual failure calibration is unverified.
Five-year conversion 1-(1-p)^5 assumes constant annual risk and is not validated.
Full scoring covariates determine member normalization, including systems with unknown outcomes.

input_audit.status_reference_evidence: 2025 Needs Assessment p.75 uses Failing list at 2024-12-31, queried 2025-03-04; annual file names do not establish July status.

saved_comparison.definition: Exact original system IDs and November-2026 outcomes, compared to rebuilt-input predictions; configurations were reselected using training/validation only.

stage1_complete_case_sensitivity.definition: Point estimates on the same fixed predictions after excluding missing stage-1 forecasts; no refitting or renormalization.

limitations: One annual held-out transition; intervals condition on the fitted models and observed prevalence and do not capture year-to-year drift, model-selection uncertainty or regional dependence.
Model configurations were already developed with this test year visible. This is a diagnostic re-evaluation of the existing model, not a new untouched test.

Historical features use event-time-v2: mutable snapshots and undated lead/copper excluded; prior-year archived sizes only, no current-size fallback. Source publication dates and retrospective revisions remain unverified.

The supplied 2024 risk workbook was modified 2025-06-23, after its nominal cutoff. Year-labelled workbooks are retrospective proxies, not verified original releases. The 2025 assessment uses December 2024 Failing-list status, not July 2025 status. These are snapshot-transition probabilities; annual failure calibration is unverified.

Probability calibration is selected by nested folds within 2024-to-2025 training data only and frozen before diagnostic evaluation; no 2025-to-2026 outcomes fit or select its map. Normalization still depends on full scoring-cohort covariates. Base configuration selection is not nested.
Systems missing a next-snapshot outcome are excluded from metrics but retained in the probability-normalization cohort. Attrition may still bias measured performance.
The five-year conversion 1-(1-p)^5 assumes constant annual risk and has not been validated on five-year outcomes. Report annual probabilities as approximate.
Current registry, system type, deactivation dates, coordinates and county define a retrospective cohort/location proxy; missing historical systems and changed locations remain unverified.
The app snapshot and funding plans are not regenerated by this command. These diagnostic results do not update existing app claims.

split.target: non-Failing at baseline, Failing at next known snapshot
